objective.title: Objective
objective.text: Your goal is to empty your 13-card personal pile. To do this, build scales in the central piles from Ace to Queen and play the cards from your personal pile onto them.

board.title: The Board
board.centralText: Build scales here from Ace (A) to Queen (Q). Kings (K) act as wild cards.
board.sideText: You have 4 side piles. Cards placed here form stacks and can be used to help organize your hand and prepare future plays.
board.personalText: You start with 13 cards in your personal pile. Your objective is to play all of them onto the central piles.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
howToPlay.step1: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.
howToPlay.step2: Play as many cards as you can. If you have an Ace, you can use it to start a new central scale. Then continue the scale in order.
howToPlay.step3: Use your side piles to store cards and help you set up future plays.
howToPlay.step4: End your turn by placing a card onto one of your 4 side piles.

scales.title: Building Scales
scales.text: Central piles must be built in order, starting with an Ace and continuing through Queen.
scales.ace: An Ace can only be used to start a new scale.
scales.king: A King is a wild card and can represent any card needed to continue a scale.

king.title: The King
king.text: Kings are wild cards. They can be used as any card needed to continue a scale.
king.cannotStart: A King cannot be used to start a new scale. Every scale must begin with an Ace.
king.noDoubleKing: You cannot use Kings twice in a row in the same scale.

turn.title: Your Turn
turn.text: At the start of your turn, draw cards until you have 5 cards. Then play cards from your hand and your personal pile whenever possible.
turn.ending: When you are finished playing, place one card onto one of your 4 side piles. This ends your turn.

winning.title: How to Win
winning.text: Keep moving cards from your personal pile onto the central scales. The first player to completely empty their 13-card personal pile and end the turn with their last card in the hand wins!
